# Getting help

- **Questions, install help and feature ideas:** the [Telegram group](https://t.me/+CWcRkoSK65kzODQx).
- **Bugs:** open an [issue](https://github.com/DJG3DK/persei/issues/new/choose) with what you did,
  what happened and the version (Settings shows it).
- **Security problems:** report them [privately](https://github.com/DJG3DK/persei/security/advisories/new),
  never in a public issue or the group.
- **Setup and configuration:** [INSTALL.md](../INSTALL.md) covers it end to end.
